english.quote: A total/overall score of 7 or higher will satisfy BU’s English Language proficiency requirement for all programs.
english.notes: IELTS Academic 7 overall satisfies the requirement 'for all programs'; component scores reviewed 'for consistency', no stated per-band minimum. TOEFL iBT and DET are worded as 'most competitive' ranges (TOEFL 90-100 with 20 per section; new scale 5.0+; DET 125-135), not minimums, so they are left out. IELTS Indicator and One Skill Retake not accepted. A test is required when English is not the first language. Round-1 quote was the TOEFL sentence, which does not contain the IELTS figure.
